name: Treasure In Heaven
overview: Scripture teaches that believers are called to prioritize eternal rewards over earthly wealth, as treasures on earth are temporary and subject to decay and theft, while treasures in heaven are imperishable and secure. Jesus warns against practicing righteousness for human approval, emphasizing that true reward comes from God alone. The heart’s allegiance is revealed by where one places their treasure, and since one cannot serve both God and money, followers must choose to seek heavenly riches by living in obedience and generosity, as exemplified by Jesus' call to sell possessions and give to the poor to gain treasure in heaven.
